name: Cleric Mystic Pilgrim
body:
Some clerics eschew the tight strictures of the ecclesiastical orders. They instead become wandering ascetics blessed by their devotion of experience and learning without adhering directly to any deity or faith in particular.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A mystic pilgrim does not gain proficiency with armor or shields, nor do they gain proficiency with their deity’s favored weapon. They retain proficiency with simple weapons. This ability modifies the mystic pilgrim’s proficiencies.

Pilgrim’s Protection (Su)

At 1st level, if a mystic pilgrim is wearing no armor or shield, they gain a sacred (or profane if they channel negative energy or are evil in alignment) bonus to their AC equal to 1/4 their class level plus their Charisma modifier. This AC bonus does not stack with other unarmored AC boosts like those provided by the monk class. This bonus is lost if the mystic pilgrim is carrying a heavy load or is helpless.

Lack of Domains (Ex)

A mystic pilgrim does not gain domains, domain abilities, or domain spell slots. This ability replaces domains.

Wandering Pilgrim (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, a mystic pilgrim gains a +2 bonus on Craft (alchemy), Profession (herbalist), Knowledge (nature), and Survival checks. They also gain Knowledge (nature) and Survival as class skills.

Potion Brewer (Ex)

At 1st level, a mystic pilgrim gains the Brew Potion feat as a bonus feat. At 5th level, they are considered to have access to all sorcerer/wizard spells of 1st-level or lower for purposes of using Brew Potion. At 10th level, this increases to 2nd-level or lower. At 15th level, this increases to 3rd-level or lower.

Charming Wanderer (Ex)

A mystic pilgrim adds all charm and compulsion spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list to their cleric spell list. They must still prepare these spells as normal and they are treated as divine spells.

Resist Charms (Ex)

At 4th level, a mystic pilgrim gains a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against charm or compulsion effects. Gem Magician (Su)

At 8th level, a mystic pilgrim gains Imbue Gem as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. They are also able to imbue divine spells into the gem if they so wish.

Timeless Body (Ex)

At 20th level, a mystic pilgrim no longer takes penalties to their ability scores for aging and cannot be magically aged. Any such penalties that they have already taken, however, remain in place. Age bonuses still accrue, and the mystic pilgrim still dies of old age when their time is up.
